title: The Map of Marvelous Islands
moral: The greatest treasure is friendship and shared adventures.

scenes.summary: Cap’n Molly finds a magical map and begins an adventure.
scenes.text: Cap’n Molly found a map in a bottle and decided to explore magical islands with her crew.

story: Cap’n Molly sailed with her crew on The Starfish Surprise when she found a magical map in a bottle. The map led them to three mysterious islands filled with challenges. On the first island, they solved a riddle together. On the second, they proved their loyalty by helping each other. On the third, Molly showed kindness to a powerful creature instead of fighting. In the end, they found a treasure that taught them that friendship, courage, and teamwork were more valuable than gold. They sailed away happily, ready for new adventures.
